subject.title: fix(agents): emit diagnostic when sessions_yield parks without continuation evidence

question: Should yielded turns suppress this diagnostic only for the six evidence categories in hasYieldContinuationEvidence, or must OpenClaw recognize a broader registry-backed set of pending wake sources first?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but the accepted evidence set defines when OpenClaw may leave a paused turn without a normal assistant payload; source inspection and tests cannot determine the intended permanent product contract.

options.title: Accept the narrow contract
options.body: Treat the six current evidence categories as sufficient for this additive diagnostic and track stricter sessions_yield validation separately.

options.title: Broaden evidence first
options.body: Define and expose a canonical registry-backed pending-wake abstraction, then make the diagnostic consume that broader contract before merge.

options.title: Require tool-level rejection
options.body: Pause this PR until sessions_yield itself can reject or downgrade invalid yields rather than diagnosing them at terminal resolution.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Treat the six current evidence categories as sufficient for this additive diagnostic and track stricter sessions_yield validation separately.

likelyOwner.reason: jriff introduced sessions_yield and its original cooperative waiting semantics, making them the strongest available history-based owner for confirming the suppression contract.
